ideas.pitch: A low-bandwidth, offline-first triage and telemedicine PWA optimized for rural West Bengal clinics with intermittent internet connectivity.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare. Think about diagnostics, telemedicine platforms, mental health.
ideas.title: ArogyaNet: Offline-First Rural Telemedicine & Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the HealthTech track with a pragmatic architectural approach (offline-first PWA with local symptom embeddings) directly addresses rural healthcare access bottlenecks in West Bengal, making it deeply relevant to Jadavpur University judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered peer support matching and sentiment monitoring platform supporting Bengali and regional dialects for localized mental healthcare.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare. Think about diagnostics, telemedicine platforms, mental health.
ideas.title: Sahayika: Regional Dialect Mental Health Peer Support Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mental health platforms rarely cater to regional Indian languages. Incorporating localized dialect processing appeals strongly to the local pride and contextual relevance criteria set by Jadavpur University evaluators.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and ledger platform verifying the quality grading and carbon footprint of West Bengal's jute agricultural supply chain.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare. Think about diagnostics, telemedicine platforms, mental health.
ideas.title: JuteTrace: AI Supply Chain Carbon & Quality Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: By tying the solution directly to West Bengal's staple agricultural economy (jute) while tracking carbon metrics, it creates undeniable localized economic and environmental impact that judges prioritize.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web app utilizing smartphone camera magnification and computer vision to verify packaging watermarks and detect counterfeit medicines common in remote districts.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare. Think about diagnostics, telemedicine platforms, mental health.
ideas.title: MedVerify: Counterfeit Drug Detection via Mobile Microscopy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackling spurious drug distribution is a severe public health crisis in eastern India. A technical implementation solving a life-or-death verification problem guarantees strong judging scores on impact.

ideas.pitch: A spatial-temporal clustering dashboard that aggregates anonymized syndromic logs from local pharmacies to predict regional disease outbreaks in West Bengal.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare. Think about diagnostics, telemedicine platforms, mental health.
ideas.title: VaidyaPulse: Predictive Outbreak Monitoring for Local Dispensaries
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines epidemiological forecasting with actionable public health infrastructure, replicating the rigorous predictive modeling approach seen in top-tier hackathon winners.
